business.what_it_does: An omnichannel shared inbox and AI customer support platform that centralizes website chat, mobile chat, and other channels into one inbox, with AI Agents and AI-driven tools like Magic Replies and a no-code chatbot builder.
business.category: AI customer support / live chat / shared inbox platform

facts.statement: Crisp is trusted by 10,000 companies of all sizes.

provenance.quote: Trusted by 10,000 companies of all sizes

facts.statement: Crisp offers a 14-day free trial with all features and no card required.

provenance.quote: 14 days free trial — All Crisp features — No card required

facts.statement: The Free plan includes a website chat widget, 2 seats, and no AI credits.
AI Credits scale with plan: Free has $0 (0 conversations), Mini ~90 automated conversations for $5, Essentials ~450 for $25, Plus ~1350 for $75.

provenance.quote: AI Credits | $ 0 | Around 90 automated conversations $ 5 | Around 450 automated conversations $ 25 | Around 1350 automated conversations $ 75

facts.statement: Customer profile limits differ by plan: 100 (Free), 5000 (Mini), 50000 (Essentials), 200000 (Plus).
Additional agents on the Plus plan cost $10/month per seat beyond the 20+ included.
Reedsy used Crisp's AI-driven Magic Replies to decrease average response times by five minutes.

provenance.quote: Crisp's AI-driven Magic Replies helped Reedsy decrease average response times by five minutes, enhancing customer satisfaction.

facts.statement: Reedsy is a fully remote team of 50, with 10 support agents relying on Crisp daily.

provenance.quote: As a fully remote team of 50, Reedsy benefits greatly from Crisp's organized and remote-friendly platform. With 10 support agents relying on Crisp daily

facts.statement: Decathlon's Laurent Hayoz said the Crisp flat price Paid plan for up to 20 users impressed them after trialling 5 competing products.

provenance.quote: We trialled 5 competing products, not realising Crisp had been developed over the years and now has been significantly developed and meets/exceeds our (above) needs. The Crisp flat price Paid plan for up to 20 users blew us away!

facts.statement: Crisp provides developer references for REST API, RTM API, Web Hooks, and Plugin Widgets, allowing custom integrations.

provenance.quote: REST API Reference RTM API Reference Web Hooks Reference Plugin Widgets Reference

facts.statement: Crisp can be installed on a custom website by copying a chatbox script into the site's HTML.

provenance.quote: The easiest way to add Crisp to a custom website is to copy your Crisp chatbox script and paste it into your website HTML.

facts.statement: If a platform blocks third-party JavaScript, Crisp cannot load until that platform or plan allows custom scripts.

provenance.quote: If your platform does not allow third-party JavaScript, Crisp cannot load until custom scripts are supported on that platform or plan.
